title: Bind stale ActiveJobs cleanup to immutable process identity
summary: Prevent stale validate-only cleanup from terminating a reused PID when current process identity contradicts or cannot prove the recorded launch.
reason: Remediate P1 AUDIT-FIND-W03-001. The current ActiveJobs identity reducer lets a matching working directory override a contradictory command line and records no immutable process creation time before authorizing tree termination.
behavior_before: A reused PID with the recorded cwd but an unrelated inspectable command line is accepted as the stale launch and can have its process tree killed.
behavior_after: New launch records carry process creation time; cleanup requires that immutable identity and rejects every inspectable cwd or command-line contradiction, while unverifiable identity remains blocking.
tests_added: tests/python/desktop/test_contracts.py: optional finite process_create_time contract round-trip.

tests/python/desktop/test_service_process_active_jobs.py: launch-time capture, same-cwd/contradictory-command rejection, creation-time mismatch, missing immutable identity fail-closed, pre-termination PID-reuse recheck, and verified matching cleanup.
manual_validation: Current-byte reproduction confirmed: active_job_pid_matches_record returned true when cwd matched and cmdline contradicted, and the fake cleanup executed the kill path.
